verdict.rationale: Lever is a SaaS ATS with public developer API documentation, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. The evidence covers only conventional API reference pages (applications, webhooks, OAuth, audit events) and marketing pages, with no mention of llms.txt, machine-readable doc indexes, or docs written for AI agents. Standard human-oriented API docs are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
